language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The robot grasps the wooden spoon at frames 62–75 and lifts it from the table at frames 76–90 (image, left_ego_image, wrist_image). It carries the spoon to the open drawer and releases it at frames 130–134; the spoon is visibly resting inside the drawer at frames 135–145 (image, wrist_image). It remains in the drawer through frame 163 (image) as the empty gripper withdraws. No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visible.
